notes.title: It has a release date!
notes.notes:
Hello and thanks for the support and interest in Lil Big Invasion.

Testing has finally come to an end and Lil Big Invasion is set to be released on [b]August 4th[/b] :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25570572/62f1a28c502086f9193517206246d0f8ac5960cd.png[/img]

Have a nice day...
